detail.description:
The hotel is centrally located, 13 km away from Connaught Place and New Delhi railway station. The hotel is located very near to famous eateries, shopping places, commercial places and various entertainment options.

This luxurious hotel provides a comprehensive and impressive range of facilities that are aimed at providing an excellent level of service to make guests' stay as comfortable as possible. Guests are welcomed into the lobby with 24-hour reception. Facilities include Internet access, room and laundry services as well as a car park. Guests can also dine in the restaurant.

The hotel provides 24 well-appointed rooms in different categories. All rooms are centrally air-conditioned along with modern facilities such as cable network TV, a telephone, safe and Internet access. The rooms are also en suite with a shower and bath.

hotelDetailMap.title: Description
hotelDetailMap.data:
The hotel is centrally located, 13 km away from Connaught Place and New Delhi railway station. The hotel is located very near to famous eateries, shopping places, commercial places and various entertainment options.

This luxurious hotel provides a comprehensive and impressive range of facilities that are aimed at providing an excellent level of service to make guests' stay as comfortable as possible. Guests are welcomed into the lobby with 24-hour reception. Facilities include Internet access, room and laundry services as well as a car park. Guests can also dine in the restaurant.

The hotel provides 24 well-appointed rooms in different categories. All rooms are centrally air-conditioned along with modern facilities such as cable network TV, a telephone, safe and Internet access. The rooms are also en suite with a shower and bath.

hotelDetailMap.title: Rules and Policies
data:
• Hotels may charge a security deposit at the time of check in, which will be refundable if unutilized.
  • Check in & Check out time is for information purposes and may change without intimation.
  • Early Check in and Late check out are subject to availability and as per Hotel Policy.
  • Carrying valid ID proof and Voucher copy is recommended.
  • Any Supplementary charges / Gala Dinner / City Tax etc. to be paid directly at the property.
  • Bedding type is subject to availability at the time of check in.
  • Extra beds are not included in the reservation price unless stated in the hotel / booking policies.
  • Hotels may not allow any additional passenger apart from those reflecting in the booking.
  • Special Requests are subject to availability and cannot be pre confirmed / guaranteed.
  • Hotels may deny check in or charge a different amount if the nationality is different than mentioned at the time of reservation.
  • To avail any complementary service, guests need to contact the hotel directly. Hotel reserves the rights to accept, deny or withdraw the same.

• Extra-person charges may apply and vary depending on property policy
  • Government-issued photo identification and a credit card, debit card, or cash deposit may be required at check-in for incidental charges
  • Special requests are subject to availability upon check-in and may incur additional charges; special requests cannot be guaranteed
  • This property accepts credit cards; cash is not accepted
  • Only bookings from non-local guests are accepted; guests whose residence is within the same city as the property will not be allowed to check in
  • Safety features at this property include a carbon monoxide detector, a fire extinguisher, a smoke detector, a security system, a first aid kit, and window guards
  • Please note that cultural norms and guest policies may differ by country and by property; the policies listed are provided by the property

Front desk staff will greet guests on arrival at the property. For any questions, please contact the property using the information on the booking confirmation. Information provided by the property may be translated using automated translation tools. Please note that PAN cards are not accepted as identification at this property.

• Only registered guests are allowed in the guestrooms.
  • Contactless check-in and contactless check-out are available.

• Fee for buffet breakfast: approximately INR 250 for adults and INR 250 for children
  • Airport shuttle fee: INR 500 per person
  • Airport shuttle fee per child: INR 250 (up to 13 years old)
  • Housekeeping is available for an additional fee
  • Rollaway bed fee: INR 650.0 per night

The above list may not be comprehensive. Fees and deposits may not include tax and are subject to change.
